quest.title: Ceaseless Training
quest.description: Asakura, who was able to reclaim his weapon, is still looking for someone to help him practice his martial arts...

talks.objective: Find Asakura, who issued the commission

dialogues.speaker: Asakura
dialogues.text: Oh! It's you. Did you take my commission again? Much obliged!

dialogues.speaker: Asakura
dialogues.text: It's truly great to have someone as formidable as you to practice with me.

choices.text: Your skill with a lance has improved a lot.

response.speaker: Asakura
response.text: From what I have heard, one of the reasons why the lance was invented was that it allows someone who doesn't really know how to wield a weapon such as myself to fight with ease.

response.speaker: Asakura
response.text: After all, this type of weapon is long and sharp. Even if the wielder doesn't know how to use it, simply stabbing and swinging with it at least appears strong.

response.speaker: Asakura
response.text: However, by this rule... I actually think the humble garden fork with its three sharp tips has greater power...

choices.text: Haven't you already taken your weapon back?

response.speaker: Asakura
response.text: I did retrieve my weapon, yes, but that doesn't mean that my training is over.

response.speaker: Asakura
response.text: I had a run-in with the Kairagi before. It would be presumptuous to say that I will not run into even stronger enemies in the future.

response.speaker: Asakura
response.text: I shall never let my weapon fall into the hands of the enemy again, thus allowing my honor as a samurai be desecrated. That's the way of samurai I wish to pursue.

dialogues.speaker: Asakura
dialogues.text: You seem to have been distracted back then. Your steps were a mess and the strength of your attacks was inconsistent, sometimes strong and sometimes weak...

dialogues.speaker: Asakura
dialogues.text: That won't do. Please get ready first, and we shall give it a go again later.

dialogues.speaker: Asakura
dialogues.text: *panting* Your skills are truly far above mine...

dialogues.speaker: Asakura
dialogues.text: No! Please use all of your strength. Without practice, I won't grow further.

dialogues.speaker: Asakura
dialogues.text: Given your great strength, you must have gone through much training...

dialogues.speaker: Asakura
dialogues.text: Forgive me for being blunt, but I am really curious about how you have trained yourself.

choices.text: A giant dragon once helped me practice flying.

response.speaker: Asakura
response.text: You... you flew with a giant dragon? That's unimaginable...

response.speaker: Asakura
response.text: Hahaha, is that so? Then I guess you must be really gifted then.

response.speaker: Asakura
response.text: Thank you for sparring with me. I will remember what you have taught me. Please take these as compensation.

choices.text: A great wolf aids me in practicing my martial arts.

response.speaker: Asakura
response.text: That sounds truly brave. I really wish I could see you and the great wolf fighting against each other...

dialogues.speaker: Asakura
dialogues.text: *sigh* Well, that's all for chit-chat. I don't believe that I should be wasting your time.

dialogues.speaker: Asakura
dialogues.text: Mm. Please, take your time, and let me know when you are ready.

dialogues.speaker: Asakura
dialogues.text: Please don't hold back, give me all you have.
